result.reason: The verse says his body will not reach his fathers’ tomb, which does not mean that it will not be buried anywhere. The question is also overly broad about what the word says and the window does not explicitly identify the quoted words as Yahweh’s word. It should ask what will happen to the man’s body, with the answer that it will not reach his fathers’ tomb.
